description: React component for creating and managing API keys, including form handling, API calls, and UI modals for key creation, user creation, and key display.

classes.name: CreateKey
classes.description: React functional component for creating API keys with various configuration options, including user assignment, model selection, guardrails, pass-through routes, and advanced settings.

methods.name: getPredefinedTags
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates tags from provided data.

methods.name: fetchTeamModels
methods.description: Fetches models available to a team for a specific user and role.

methods.name: fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches models available to a user and updates state.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Resets modal state and form fields after key creation modal is closed.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets modal state and form fields when key creation modal is canceled.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new API key, including validation, API calls, and state updates.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Displays success notification when key is copied to clipboard.

methods.name: fetchMcpAccessGroups
methods.description: Fetches MCP access groups for the current access token.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users by email and updates user options.

methods.name: handleUserCreated
methods.description: Callback for when a new user is created, updates form and state.

methods.name: handleUserSearch
methods.description: Debounced search handler for user email search.

methods.name: handleUserSelect
methods.description: Sets selected user ID in form upon user selection.
